Despite this semantic mismatch, the visual quality of the generated subjects is excellent.
key_defects: Counting error: Image shows 5 penguins instead of the requested 6.
Taxonomy mismatch: Rendered penguins resemble African Penguins (white head band, black chest stripe) rather than King Penguins (orange ear patches, pink bill base).
